summary: Cemetery Ridge lookout, Wallowa County: L-4 cab built 1940, named watchers to 1951, gone; a 1947 move to Buckhorn Mountain is unconfirmed and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. FFLOS says the cab may have moved to Buckhorn Mountain in 1947; Buckhorn's own record credits a cab moved from Fairchild Point in 1952. A weebly page quotes a 1954 history saying the lookout blew over in 1952.

events.note: L-4 cab, per FFLOS and firelookout.com.
Fred Beaudoin is the earliest named lookout on firelookout.com. The first staffing year is not documented.
FFLOS says the L-4 cab may have been moved to Buckhorn Mountain in 1947. Not confirmed by any other source read.
Robert Spencer is the last named lookout on firelookout.com. Staffing after this year is not documented in the sources read.
Weebly quotes a 1954 history: the Cemetery lookout blew over the hill that fall. Firelookout.com credits the Buckhorn cab to a 1952 move from Fairchild Point, not from Cemetery Ridge.
Registered with the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register on July 27, 2011.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS says the cab may have moved to Buckhorn Mountain in 1947. The Buckhorn Mountain record says its L-4 cab came from Fairchild Point in 1952. A weebly page quotes a 1954 history that a Cemetery lookout blew over in 1952. No source read confirms a move from Cemetery Ridge, so the story reports the 1947 move as unconfirmed.

notes_for_editor: The core facts (1940 L-4 cab, listed as gone, named watchers 1942-1951) agree across FFLOS and firelookout.com. The fate of the cab is contested: FFLOS suggests a 1947 move to Buckhorn Mountain, Buckhorn's own record says its cab came from Fairchild Point in 1952, and a 1954 history quoted on weebly says the Cemetery lookout blew over in 1952. No source read describes the site today. The 1954 history is only available through the weebly transcription. The brief's kind field (ground) is not contradicted by any source read, but no source describes the structure's form. A search snippet about a 2021 hiking trip past Cemetery Ridge was not read and is not used. The staffing as_of 1952 is the year the lookout is said to have blown over; the last named lookout is 1951.
